title: [LPB] Legit Performance Booster
description: LPB: Legit Performance Boost is a streamlined Fabric modpack that maximizes FPS and eliminates lag by using only essential, up-to-date performance mods—no bloat, just pure optimization.
body:
# LPB: Legit Performance Boost

Want Minecraft to run faster and smoother? With LPB: Legit Performance Boost, **you get up to 300% better performance!** This modpack is designed to increase your **FPS, reduce lag, and make Minecraft run smoothly,** without any unnecessary or outdated mods.

### Why Choose LPB?

✅ **Up to 300% better performance** – Play Minecraft faster and smoother than ever before.

✅ **Only the best mods** – No unnecessary or outdated mods, just what really works for better performance.

✅ **Nice extras included** – Features a custom music pack ("Better Music for Menu & Discs") and lightweight resource packs for a better experience without losing performance.

✅ **Easy to install** – If you don't wanna use the CurseForge app, just drag and drop the files into your mods and resourcepacks folders and play! 

✅ **Even easier** – If you are tirred of drag and dropping?, you can install/use the offical CurseForge app to download to pack and play even faster!

### Key Features
Sodium, Lithium, Phosphor, FerriteCore, and Krypton for the best FPS boost.
Dynamic FPS and Reese’s Sodium Options for even smoother gameplay.
Custom music and lightweight resource packs for a better experience without lag.
No heavy mods or shaders – just pure performance improvement.
Installation (without the CurseForge app)
Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft version.
Place all mods in the mods folder.
Add the resource packs to the resourcepacks folder.
Launch Minecraft and enjoy super smooth performance with up to 300% better FPS!

### Notes
Use Java 17 or higher for the best results.
Works on multiplayer servers, but some servers may block certain mods.
Compatible with multiple Minecraft versions (check which mods are compatible with your version).

_Download now and experience Minecraft like never before with LPB: Legit Performance Boost!_ 🚀
